node.title: Printing a UTF8 code
node.author: bobt_1234
node.doctext: Hi Monks. I'm hoping to gain some perl wisdom about outputting unicode or "utf8" codes. I've tried things like open FO, ">test.txt"; binmode FO, ":utf8"; print FO "\u00b9" But it doesn't work. The output is "00b9". I've tried other things like print FO "\u-00b9"; # Outputs -00b9 print FO "\u{00b9}"; # Outputs {00b9} print FO "\x{00b9}"; # Outputs a strange character (the code for 00b9 is a superscript 1} I've tried searching the Internet to no avail. Every page on this topic requires you to read an encyclopedia. All I want is the code to output a unicode literal. Thanks everyone!
